description: 播放短小循环感舞蹈，适合活泼性格。
imagePrompt: Create exactly six temporally ordered frames of a short playful in-place dance by the same subject, ending close to the starting pose. Keep identity, body proportions, camera distance, visual mass, horizontal centroid and ground baseline stable; avoid large jumps or moves that leave the cell. No music notes, motion marks, text, floor or props.
